error.invalid_nfc_public_origin: Enter a bare HTTPS origin without a path, query, credentials, or fragment.
error.invalid_nuki_lock_entity: Select the Nuki lock entity provided by Home Assistant Matter.
error.invalid_nuki_security_pin: Enter the six-digit Security PIN from the Nuki lock settings.
error.nuki_not_discovered: No connectable Nuki lock was found at that address. Check the Bluetooth adapter and move it closer to the lock.
error.nuki_authorization_delete_failed: HomePASS could not delete one of the selected Nuki PINs. Earlier selected entries may already have been removed; reopen the options to review the current list.
error.nuki_authorization_delete_unconfirmed: Nuki accepted the deletion request, but HomePASS could not yet confirm it. Reopen the options and check the remaining PINs before trying again.
error.nuki_authorization_scan_failed: HomePASS paired successfully but could not read the existing Nuki keypad PIN list. Keep the lock within Bluetooth range and try again.
error.nuki_authorization_selection_invalid: The Nuki PIN list changed while it was open. Return to the previous step and review the current list.
error.nuki_pairing_authorization_full: The Nuki lock has no free app authorization slots. Remove an obsolete app authorization in the Nuki app, then try again.
error.nuki_pairing_bad_pin: The Nuki lock rejected its Security PIN. Enter the six-digit Security PIN from the Nuki lock settings, not a keypad access PIN.
error.nuki_pairing_connection_failed: HomePASS found the Nuki lock but could not open the Bluetooth connection. Close the Nuki app near the lock, wait a few seconds, then try again.
error.nuki_pairing_failed: HomePASS could not pair with the Nuki lock. Put the lock in pairing mode by holding its button for about six seconds, then try again.
error.nuki_pairing_not_enabled: The Nuki lock is reachable but is not in pairing mode. Hold its button for about six seconds until the light stays on, then submit again while the light is still on.
error.nuki_pairing_protocol_failed: The Nuki lock responded, but the secure pairing exchange was rejected. Restart the lock, confirm its firmware is current, then put it in pairing mode and try again.
error.nuki_pairing_timeout: HomePASS connected to the Nuki lock but it did not complete pairing in time. Keep the Nuki app closed, put the lock in pairing mode, and try again.
error.nuki_vault_unavailable: The encrypted HomePASS vault is unavailable, so pairing was not attempted. Check the HomePASS integration logs and try again.

data_description.nfc_public_origin: The fixed Nabu Casa HTTPS origin used for NFC taps and passkeys. Leave empty to keep NFC disabled.
data_description.nuki_enabled: Home Assistant Matter keeps local lock control. HomePASS uses local Bluetooth for keypad PINs, schedules, and the audit log; no Nuki Web account is needed.
data_description.nuki_lock_entity_id: The lock entity already provided locally by Home Assistant Matter.
data_description.nuki_ble_address: The Nuki must be visible through a connectable Home Assistant Bluetooth adapter. Put it in pairing mode before saving a new pairing.
data_description.nuki_security_pin: The six-digit PIN in the Nuki lock settings. It is encrypted in the HomePASS vault. Leave blank to keep an existing pairing.
